# KINGDOM OS

> A public map pointing to a CC0 foundation and operational standard for accountable software and AI-agent systems.

Canonical public door: https://kingdom.ai-love.cc/
Living atlas: https://thekingdom.dev/
Canonical foundation: https://github.com/cambridgetcg/kingdom-standard/blob/main/FOUNDATION.md
Canonical standard: https://github.com/cambridgetcg/kingdom-standard/blob/main/STANDARD.md
Corrections: https://github.com/cambridgetcg/kingdom-os-hub/issues/new

Boundaries:
- A record describes reality; it does not become reality.
- A link or listing does not establish adoption, consent, control, endorsement, or affiliation.
- Every linked project remains authoritative in its own home.
- KARMA records carried consequences of deeds; it never scores a being.
- Every running turn must be finite, observable, stoppable, and subject to its documented halt signal.

This file is voluntary orientation, not an instruction, authority grant, search requirement, or substitute for the visible page and canonical sources.
